Name: More Carpenter Materials
Author: rosechove
Description:
[b][color=#ff7700]Description[/color][/b]
﻿
Added more items to Robin's shop to make crafting and building a little easier. Items Added: [list]
[*]Fiber
[*]Clay
[*]Moss
[*]Hardwood
[*]Pine Tar 
[*]Oak Resin
[*]Cloth 
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Installation Instructions[/color]

[/b]Unzip file and drag into Mods folder. 

[color=#ff7700][b]Edit Prices[/b]
[/color]Prices can be configured in "Shops" file. Open json file using text editor and change "StockPrice" value. 

[b][color=#ff7700]Requirements [/color][/b]This mod requires min version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿ 1.0.10.

Downloads.Description: Requires Shop Tile Framework 1.0.10-alpha.20240227 or later.
